data.name: Ingamar
data.gender_notes: Ingamar is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old Norse, Ingamar means 'God of Ing, warrior'. Ing was an old Norse god associated with fertility, agrarian abundance, and the peace that comes from prosperity. The name Ingamar pays homage to both the divine and the warrior spirit. The name Ingamar carries the meaning “Ing, god + mar, warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ingamar usually hope their child will grow to embody ing, god + mar, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of divine inspiration and warrior spirit.
data.etymology: Ingamar belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ing, god + mar, warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ingamar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
data.cultural_impact: The name Ingamar reflects the rich Nordic heritage, bridging the gap between ancient Norse mythology and the Christian faith. It represents a fusion of two distinct cultural influences, preserving the historical significance of Norse gods and their connection to the land and people.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ingamar holds spiritual significance for those seeking a reminder of the divine presence and strength that resides within us as warriors in our own lives. It encourages the notion of fighting for what we believe in with courage, determination, and hope for abundance and prosperity.
